# form.addStaticText

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Add a static text to the current form.

```lua
form.addStaticText(line, rect, text)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the text should be added |
| `rect` | Rect | yes | the coordinates |
| `text` | string | yes | the displayed text |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua
local line = form.addLine("Firmware")
form.addStaticText(line, nil, system.getVersion().version)
```

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.addStaticText(line, nil, "Static Text")
```
